root_cause_finding.summary: Gemini Grounding API chunk.web.uri returns Vertex AI redirect URL (vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/...) instead of the actual source domain. The actual domain is stored in chunk.web.title (e.g., 'jiji.com'). Original _search_with_grounding() used chunk.web.uri for WL matching, causing structural always-False has_jp_coverage in production.
root_cause_finding.resolution: Added domain-extraction layer (_extract_domain_from_chunk / _looks_like_domain / _normalize_domain) with 2 fallback strategies (chunk.web.domain → chunk.web.title) to provide SDK-version resilience. _search_with_grounding() now reads via _extract_domain_from_chunk and pushes 'https://<domain>' for WL matching.

remeasurement_note: Post-fix re-measurement still shows verdict=fail (Recall covered 71.43%, Precision blind 42.86%, F1 0.769, Tier accuracy 30%). Structural bug is resolved (TP=10 vs original TP=0, FN=4 vs original FN=14). Remaining gaps (Recall ↑ needed, Tier ranking issues, FP from diamond.jp) are out-of-scope for F-jp-coverage-improve and reported as 想定外結果. See CURRENT_STATE / DECISION_LOG / FUTURE_WORK for next-batch routing.
